title: Generator identity for base localization comparison
statement: Under the compatible ring, algebra, scalar tower, derived category, localization, complex, and model hypotheses of lem-pc-base-localization-comparison, and for an ordinary-complex isomorphism tau satisfying the displayed tensor-generator formula, the composite L.localizedComparison i followed by HomologicalComplex.homologyMap tau.hom i sends every element 1 tensor x to K.localizedComparison i applied to 1 tensor the canonical base-localization cohomology map of x.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8 affine localization identity; Tag 06Y6 universal counit and localization tensor identity

proof.text: Expand localized_eq and comparison_eq for L and K, use the universal counit equation for baseLocalizationDerivedMap, and evaluate the resulting ordinary square on the tensor generators. The hypothesis hτ identifies the ordinary-complex map on d tensor x, yielding the canonical baseLocalizationCohomologyMap. The full generator calculation is left as this named theorem.
